I left the hospital without much trouble, but my mind was still full of questions…
How could she have done it to us?! 
I understand that she went through a lot, but that’s not the way to end things!
Jesus…
What am I supposed to do now? Can I really go back to my flat? What am I supposed to say to {f_botName}? That because of me Melissa-{{wi}} no, Amei- died? 
No amount of time walking around the city will make this whole situation any better…
I need to calm down…
Nothing comes to my head… {{wi}}Blood is rushing through my body and I cannot collect my thoughts whatsoever…
I need to go home…
